in_marathi.name: Sounak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sounak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sounak is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sau' meaning sound and 'naka' meaning echo. It is a name that is deeply rooted in the ancient Indian culture and spirituality.
